label: main season
summary: Recommend further non-technical survey. E1 is weak, unverified second-hand indirect evidence (reliability class 7), and this is only the first visit, so it has not met the criteria for follow-up as a clearance target. E2 supports absence only along the paths and field edges observed; it does not establish sufficient grounds to cancel or explain E1. The nearby recorded accident is within 1 km, not recorded inside the area.
flags: The zone survey flag and survey priority indicate where to visit, not evidence of contamination.
The survey team observed paths and field edges in a 100% forest area; the observation does not establish that the full area was assessed.

checks.detail: Further non-technical survey is always open.

E1.quote: A trader passing through the vereda said people should keep away from the area because of mines, but could not say who had seen anything, or where.
E1.note: This is a second-hand warning from an outsider who cannot identify any first-hand witness or location, so it suggests possible contamination but is weak indirect evidence.

E2.quote: The survey team walked the paths and field edges of the area and saw no items, signs, fencing or other marks of contamination.
E2.note: The team’s own observation of no indicators along paths and field edges supports absence in the observed locations, but does not establish safe use or explain the unverified warning.
